reason: I already get captions from ChatGPT with a saved brief per client and I'm not going to rebuild 12 client voices in a new tool for something I mostly get already. The approval link is nice, but my clients already approve over WhatsApp and I'd rather not add another thing to my Monday.
objection: I already get this from ChatGPT with a saved brief per client, so I'd be paying 19 a month on top of my 20 for the same captions plus a nicer approval link.
